sledgewire.smoke.summary: Discover a remote MCP service and perform one explicitly safe probe when supplied.

sledgewire.assay.summary: Run bounded adversarial protocol checks without unsafe side effects.

sledgewire.invoke.summary: Perform evidence-backed structural repair, independently validate it, and invoke the target.

sledgewire.fleet.summary: Smoke-test up to six candidate MCP services with bounded concurrency.

sledgewire.seal.summary: Produce a portable profile-versioned conformance packet for one MCP endpoint.
